prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous warm-ivory complexion, early 30s goddess, amazoness physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad; a commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist; enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves; powerful, statuesque and imposing; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, sculpted updo natural black hair — her body is painted in 5 different painting styles at once, each style claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 6 diagonal bands by 5 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper right to the lower left as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 18% of the way down her figure from the top, about 32% of the way down her figure from the top, about 47% of the way down her figure from the top, about 61% of the way down her figure from the top and about 73% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries translucent watercolour washes in rose and cerulean with pooled edges and thin downward drips. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries black-and-white op-art checkerboard distorted into a bulging optical illusion. Region 3 is the diagonal band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries high-gloss enamel paint in ruby red and cobalt blue, a mirror-glossy coat with wet-looking highlights. Region 4 is the diagonal band between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries deep Prussian-blue cyanotype prints with white fern and leaf silhouettes. Region 5 is the diagonal band between transition zone 4 and transition zone 5: it carries fluorescent UV neon paint in neon pink and acid lime lightning streaks, glowing intensely with a blacklight shimmer. Region 6 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it stays her own bare living skin with a natural satin sheen. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course, every painting laid on her own living skin, and the last region left as natural bare skin. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: standing tall facing the camera straight on, arms relaxed at her sides, weight even on both feet, her legs fully in view — most extreme amazoness silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of glossy pale blue leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each as long as her whole hand, in pale blue lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large hoop earrings of polished gold with blackened iron accents as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Chinese woman (East Asian Chinese features: a longer oval face with prominent high cheekbones and a defined jawline, long upturned phoenix-shaped eyes with sharp inner folds, a high strong nose bridge, thin arched eyebrows with a slight rise, balanced lips), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: bright pastel pink and yellow eyeshadow, thick lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, small star and heart shapes painted on the cheeks only, glossy candy-pink lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows satin skin finish, smooth silky sheen.

Background: a bright white-walled modern gallery hall with a polished pale floor and a full-height doorway standing open behind her, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
